Selecting `DonationObservationSummaryForAgent` would make the one-minute bucket aggregate the time-series measurement itself, which changes what the value means. The Data Agent and the Ontology deliberately read different objects from the same Eventhouse. The Ontology time series binds the raw `DonatedAt` and `DonationAmountYen` directly, so no deduplication happens and rows with duplicate EventIDs remain in the aggregate. The Data Agent, in contrast, sees only the curated materialized view and never receives EventID. The first exists to expose the raw observation on a time axis; the second exists to fix the grain the Agent may be given.
